optical_profile.method: independent optical pose/lens fit to mat, box corners and curved near-wall seam
uncertainties: Hand-located corners, approximately 2 px; partly occluded front corner downweighted
Metric enclosure/mat dimensions and optional known-size stereo plates; optics/pose remain image-derived
Pixel alignment estimate, not a measured metric camera calibration
optical_profile.lens_source: independent external-lens fit; wrist-camera estimate used only as a weak same-model prior

wrist_profile.method: shared multi-episode metric reprojection fit with CAD and measured mat dimensions
assumptions: Metric scale comes from enclosure/mat and CAD dimensions
No per-frame camera, robot or motor correction; last two episodes held out
Visible cream outline and tip measurements have occlusion/segmentation uncertainty
Image-derived calibration; hardware encoder calibration and measured contact properties remain unavailable
wrist_profile.source: green_cube_red_plate_1 wrist chunk; fixed jaw and moving scene features

joint_map.method: shared multi-episode metric reprojection fit with CAD and measured mat dimensions
assumptions: Metric scale comes from enclosure/mat and CAD dimensions
No per-frame camera, robot or motor correction; last two episodes held out
Visible cream outline and tip measurements have occlusion/segmentation uncertainty
Image-derived calibration; hardware encoder calibration and measured contact properties remain unavailable

encoder_scale_constraint.method: integer encoder-grid inference from all 6632 observed states
assumptions: 12-bit STS3215 position encoder, matching the supplied SO follower model
First five columns are consistent with degrees or an equivalent 2275-tick normalized span; either interpretation yields the same angular scale
Gripper remains a calibrated percentage; its inferred span is 1518 ticks
Signs follow CAD axes; absolute offsets are fitted separately

jaw_response_profile.method: unloaded command-to-observed velocity response; episodes 0-7 fit, 8-9 validate
assumptions: Fit uses measured motion in open gaps, excluding the cube-loaded stall
Torque limit, damping, friction and compliance remain unmeasured
The velocity controller retains physical torque saturation and contact-determined actual jaw motion

limitations: First five arm joints follow recorded observed positions; jaw driven by recorded commands
Initial object poses fitted once to both real silhouettes; no later vision corrections to physics
Friction, servo torque/gains and printed-part compliance are not measured
